note: slots[name][frame] = [a, b, c, d, tx, ty, z] in Flash px (zoom 1, y down) relative to the animation registration point (penguin body centre; feet at y ~ +28, head gear at y ~ -25); z = draw order index (higher = in front); null = slot absent. Slot names are case-insensitive in the original (DCUtils.getChildByPath).
